ABOUT US · SINCE 2011

Built on trust, delivered in containers.

For over a decade, Luxem International has given international buyers dependable, compliant access to India's finest agricultural commodities.

OUR STORY

Fourteen years of disciplined sourcing, built for international trade.

Since 2011, Luxem International has worked at the intersection of Indian agriculture and global food trade, built on a simple premise: international buyers need consistency, and India's growers and processors have the quality to deliver it. What has grown over fourteen years is not just volume, but the infrastructure of trust — verified growers, accredited testing laboratories, and documentation practices that satisfy customs authorities in every market we serve.

Today we work with growers, processing units and testing laboratories across Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, delivering eight commodity categories to trading partners across Asia, the Middle East, Europe and Africa — with the same specification, batch after batch, container after container.

Jamnagar, India

Headquartered near Gujarat's ports, giving us fast access to Kandla, Mundra and Nhava Sheva for efficient export handling.

PROCESS

A controlled process, from farm gate to final port.

Six audited stages, lab testing, full traceability and flexible packaging stand between raw commodity and container seal — so every shipment arrives exactly as specified.

OUR PROCESS

Six controlled stages, start to finish.

01

Sourcing & Farm Partnerships

We work directly with growers and mills across Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Tamil Nadu, selecting lots by region, season and variety.

02

Quality Testing & Grading

Every lot is lab-tested for moisture, aflatoxin, pesticide residue and purity, then graded to match your target market's standards.

03

Processing & Cleaning

Sortex cleaning, roasting, hulling or milling as required — carried out under hygienic, monitored conditions.

04

Packaging & Labelling

Food-grade packing in your specified format — bags, jars, drums or private-label retail units — sealed and batch-coded for traceability.

05

Documentation & Compliance

Phytosanitary certificates, certificates of origin, fumigation and quality certificates prepared in line with destination-country regulations.

06

Shipping & Delivery

Container booking, port handling and freight coordination via Mundra, Kandla and Nhava Sheva, with shipment tracking through to arrival.

LAB TESTING

Tested before you ever see the sample.

Every lot passes through our in-house quality lab before it's approved for export, with third-party NABL-accredited laboratories engaged for independent verification on request. Results are issued as a Certificate of Analysis (COA) and shared with your purchase order — not after you ask for it.

ParameterWhat It Confirms
Moisture ContentWithin specification to prevent spoilage and weight-related disputes
Purity / AdmixtureForeign matter, broken grains and off-type material within agreed tolerance
Aflatoxin & MycotoxinWithin destination-market safety limits, critical for peanuts and spices
Pesticide ResidueCompliant with importing-country maximum residue levels (MRLs)
Microbial LoadSalmonella, E. coli and total plate count within food-safety limits
Oil / Protein ContentConfirmed for sesame, soybean and oilseed categories against buyer spec
Turnaround 48–72 hours per lotReports Certificate of Analysis issued per shipmentThird-Party NABL-accredited labs on request
TRACEABILITY

Every bag traces back to its source lot.

Each shipment is batch-coded at the point of packaging, linking every bag back to its source farm, harvest season, processing date and lab test results. If a question ever comes up after delivery, we can trace it back to the exact lot in minutes, not weeks.

1

Source Recording

Farm, region and harvest date logged at intake for every lot we purchase.

2

Batch Coding

Unique batch number assigned at processing, printed on every bag, jar or carton.

3

Digital Record-Keeping

Test results, processing dates and packing records stored against each batch code.

4

Post-Delivery Support

Any quality query after delivery can be traced to its exact batch and resolved quickly.

PACKAGING

Packed to protect, shipped to specification.

Packaging is selected by product and destination climate, not a single default — moisture-sensitive categories get barrier-lined bags, bulk orders get jumbo bags or palletized cartons, and retail-bound products get consumer-ready units.

Packing Options — and what they suit

B

PP / Jute Bags

25kg & 50kg bulk bags, moisture-barrier lined. Suits commodity buyers, mills and distributors ordering by the container.

J

Jumbo Bags

500kg–1,000kg FIBC bags for high-volume industrial orders. Suits bulk buyers prioritising fewer, larger units.

D

Jars & Drums

340g–15kg jars and drums. Suits peanut butter, private-label and food-service buyers.

R

Retail Pouches

Consumer-ready, sized to market. Suits supermarket, private-label and e-commerce buyers.

Standards — food-grade packaging, documented

Every packaging material we use is food-grade certified and sourced from approved suppliers, with compliance documentation available on request. Materials are migration-safe and meet food-contact regulations in the markets we ship to — this is confirmed as part of our pre-shipment documentation, not assumed.

Marks & Labels

Marks on every bag

Batch code, product name, net weight and production date printed on every unit — the same code that ties back to your lab test results and source lot.

Labels for every market

Label language, net weight units, country-of-origin marking and regulatory text adapted to your destination market's requirements, including private-label artwork.

In Transit — protecting your goods at sea

Containers are inspected for structural integrity and odour before loading. Moisture-sensitive cargo is shipped with desiccant bags and container liners to manage condensation on long sea voyages, and loads are braced and secured to prevent shifting. We select routing and transit time with product stability in mind, particularly for categories sensitive to heat and humidity.

PRIVATE LABEL

Your brand, our production discipline.

Peanut butter, roasted peanuts, spice powders and several of our processed lines are available on a private-label or OEM basis — produced to your formulation, packed under your brand, with the same lab testing and traceability as every other Luxem shipment.

1

Formulation & Specification

We work to your recipe or specification — moisture, additive and grade requirements confirmed upfront.

2

Label & Artwork Approval

Your artwork applied to jars, pouches or cartons; a pre-production proof is approved before the full run.

3

Trial Order

Most private-label partners start with a smaller trial batch before scaling to full container volume.

4

Ongoing Production

Repeat runs follow the approved specification exactly, batch after batch.

Incoterms Quick Reference

The shipping terms most commonly used on Luxem International quotations.

EXW

Ex Works — buyer arranges all transport from our facility in Jamnagar.

FOB

Free On Board — we deliver to the vessel at Mundra / Kandla; buyer covers freight onward.

CFR

Cost and Freight — we cover freight to destination port; buyer arranges insurance.

CIF

Cost, Insurance and Freight — we cover freight and insurance to destination port.

FCA

Free Carrier — goods handed to buyer's nominated carrier at an agreed point.

DAP

Delivered At Place — we deliver to buyer's named destination, duty unpaid.
